BUFFER_SIZE = 131072


class CommandLineError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message: str, detail: Optional[str] = None, show_banner: bool = True):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.message = message
        self.detail = detail
        self.show_banner = show_banner


class ArchiveRuntimeError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message: str, detail: Optional[str] = None):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.message = message
        self.detail = detail


class BreakSignaled(Exception):
    pass


@dataclass
class Options:
    archive_type: Optional[str] = None
    output_dir: Optional[Path] = None
    stdin_name: Optional[str] = None
    use_stdin: bool = False
    to_stdout: bool = False
    technical_list: bool = False
    hash_algo: str = "CRC32"
    assume_yes: bool = False
    overwrite_mode: Optional[str] = None
    delete_sources: bool = False
    stop_on_error: bool = False
    archive_name_disabled: bool = False


@dataclass
class SourceItem:
    stored_path: str
    source_path: Optional[Path]
    is_dir: bool
    data: bytes = b""
    size: int = 0
    mtime: Optional[float] = None
    mode: int = 0o755


@dataclass
class ArchiveEntryData:
    path: str
    is_dir: bool
    data: bytes = b""
    size: Optional[int] = None
    compressed_size: Optional[int] = None
    mtime: Optional[float] = None
    mode: int = 0o755
    crc32: Optional[int] = None
    method: Optional[str] = None
    block: Optional[int] = None


@dataclass
class ArchiveSnapshot:
    archive_type: str
    path: Path
    entries: list[ArchiveEntryData]
    physical_size: int
    meta: dict[str, object] = field(default_factory=dict)


class LibArchive:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.lib = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libarchive.so.13")
        self._bind()

    def _bind(self) -> None:
        lib = self.lib

        def bind(name: str, argtypes: list[object], restype: object) -> None:
            func = getattr(lib, name)
            func.argtypes = argtypes
            func.restype = restype

        bind("archive_error_string", [ctypes.c_void_p], ctypes.c_char_p)

        bind("archive_entry_new", [], ctypes.c_void_p)
        bind("archive_entry_free", [ctypes.c_void_p], None)
        bind("archive_entry_pathname", [ctypes.c_void_p], ctypes.c_char_p)
        bind("archive_entry_size", [ctypes.c_void_p], ctypes.c_longlong)
        bind("archive_entry_mode", [ctypes.c_void_p], ctypes.c_int)
        bind("archive_entry_perm", [ctypes.c_void_p], ctypes.c_int)
        bind("archive_entry_mtime", [ctypes.c_void_p], ctypes.c_longlong)
        bind("archive_entry_mtime_nsec", [ctypes.c_void_p], ctypes.c_long)
        bind("archive_entry_filetype", [ctypes.c_void_p], ctypes.c_uint)

        bind("archive_entry_set_pathname", [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_char_p], None)
        bind("archive_entry_set_size", [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_longlong], None)
        bind("archive_entry_set_filetype", [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_uint], None)
        bind("archive_entry_set_perm", [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_uint], None)
        bind("archive_entry_set_mtime", [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_longlong, ctypes.c_long], None)

        bind("archive_read_new", [], ctypes.c_void_p)
        bind("archive_read_support_filter_all", [ctypes.c_void_p], ctypes.c_int)
        bind("archive_read_support_format_7zip", [ctypes.c_void_p], ctypes.c_int)
        bind("archive_read_support_format_raw", [ctypes.c_void_p], ctypes.c_int)
        bind("archive_read_open_filename", [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_size_t], ctypes.c_int)
        bind("archive_read_next_header2", [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p], ctypes.c_int)
        bind("archive_read_data", [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t], ctypes.c_longlong)
        bind("archive_read_data_skip", [ctypes.c_void_p], ctypes.c_int)
        bind("archive_read_close", [ctypes.c_void_p], ctypes.c_int)
        bind("archive_read_free", [ctypes.c_void_p], ctypes.c_int)
        bind("archive_format_name", [ctypes.c_void_p], ctypes.c_char_p)

        bind("archive_write_new", [], ctypes.c_void_p)
        bind("archive_write_set_format_7zip", [ctypes.c_void_p], ctypes.c_int)
        bind("archive_write_set_format_raw", [ctypes.c_void_p], ctypes.c_int)
        bind("archive_write_set_format_option", [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_char_p], ctypes.c_int)
        bind("archive_write_add_filter_zstd", [ctypes.c_void_p], ctypes.c_int)
        bind("archive_write_open_filename", [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_char_p], ctypes.c_int)
        bind("archive_write_header", [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p], ctypes.c_int)
        bind("archive_write_data", [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t], ctypes.c_longlong)
        bind("archive_write_close", [ctypes.c_void_p], ctypes.c_int)
        bind("archive_write_free", [ctypes.c_void_p], ctypes.c_int)

    def _error(self, handle: int) -> str:
        msg = self.lib.archive_error_string(handle)
        if not msg:
            return "unknown error"
        return msg.decode("utf-8", "replace")

    def read_7z(self, path: Path) -> ArchiveSnapshot:
        archive = self.lib.archive_read_new()
        if not archive:
            raise ArchiveRuntimeError("Cannot open the file as archive")
        try:
            self._check(self.lib.archive_read_support_filter_all(archive), archive, fatal=True)
            self._check(self.lib.archive_read_support_format_7zip(archive), archive, fatal=True)
            self._check(self.lib.archive_read_open_filename(archive, os.fsencode(path), 10240), archive, fatal=True)
            entry = self.lib.archive_entry_new()
            entries: list[ArchiveEntryData] = []
            try:
                while True:
                    code = self.lib.archive_read_next_header2(archive, entry)
                    if code == AR_EOF:
                        break
                    self._check(code, archive, fatal=True)
                    raw_path = self.lib.archive_entry_pathname(entry) or b""
                    name = raw_path.decode("utf-8", "surrogateescape").rstrip("/")
                    mode = self.lib.archive_entry_mode(entry) & 0o7777
                    filetype = self.lib.archive_entry_filetype(entry)
                    mtime = self.lib.archive_entry_mtime(entry)
                    mtime_nsec = self.lib.archive_entry_mtime_nsec(entry)
                    ts = float(mtime) + (mtime_nsec / 1_000_000_000.0)
                    size = self.lib.archive_entry_size(entry)
                    is_dir = filetype == AE_IFDIR
                    data = b""
                    if not is_dir:
                        chunks: list[bytes] = []
                        buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(BUFFER_SIZE)
                        while True:
                            count = self.lib.archive_read_data(archive, buf, BUFFER_SIZE)
                            if count == 0:
                                break
                            if count < 0:
                                raise ArchiveRuntimeError("Cannot open the file as archive", self._error(archive))
                            chunks.append(buf.raw[:count])
                        data = b"".join(chunks)
                        size = len(data)
                    else:
                        self._check(self.lib.archive_read_data_skip(archive), archive, fatal=True)
                    entries.append(
                        ArchiveEntryData(
                            path=name,
                            is_dir=is_dir,
                            data=data,
                            size=int(size) if size is not None and size >= 0 else None,
                            mtime=ts,
                            mode=mode or (0o755 if is_dir else 0o644),
                            crc32=(binascii.crc32(data) & 0xFFFFFFFF) if not is_dir else None,
                        )
                    )
            finally:
                self.lib.archive_entry_free(entry)
            file_count = sum(1 for item in entries if not item.is_dir)
            return ArchiveSnapshot(
                archive_type="7z",
                path=path,
                entries=entries,
                physical_size=path.stat().st_size,
                meta={
                    "Path": str(path),
                    "Type": "7z",
                    "Physical Size": path.stat().st_size,
                    "Method": "LZMA2:23",
                    "Solid": "-" if file_count <= 1 else "-",
                    "Blocks": file_count or 0,
                },
            )
        finally:
            self.lib.archive_read_close(archive)
            self.lib.archive_read_free(archive)

    def read_zstd_raw(self, path: Path) -> ArchiveSnapshot:
        archive = self.lib.archive_read_new()
        if not archive:
            raise ArchiveRuntimeError("Cannot open the file as archive")
        try:
            self._check(self.lib.archive_read_support_filter_all(archive), archive, fatal=True)
            self._check(self.lib.archive_read_support_format_raw(archive), archive, fatal=True)
            self._check(self.lib.archive_read_open_filename(archive, os.fsencode(path), 10240), archive, fatal=True)
            entry = self.lib.archive_entry_new()
            try:
                code = self.lib.archive_read_next_header2(archive, entry)
                if code == AR_EOF:
                    raise ArchiveRuntimeError("Cannot open the file as archive")
                self._check(code, archive, fatal=True)
                raw_path = self.lib.archive_entry_pathname(entry) or path.stem.encode()
                name = raw_path.decode("utf-8", "surrogateescape").rstrip("/")
                chunks: list[bytes] = []
                buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(BUFFER_SIZE)
                while True:
                    count = self.lib.archive_read_data(archive, buf, BUFFER_SIZE)
                    if count == 0:
                        break
                    if count < 0:
                        raise ArchiveRuntimeError("Cannot open the file as archive", self._error(archive))
                    chunks.append(buf.raw[:count])
                data = b"".join(chunks)
                entry_obj = ArchiveEntryData(
                    path=name or path.stem,
                    is_dir=False,
                    data=data,
                    size=len(data),
                    compressed_size=path.stat().st_size,
                    mtime=path.stat().st_mtime,
                    mode=0o644,
                    crc32=binascii.crc32(data) & 0xFFFFFFFF,
                )
                return ArchiveSnapshot(
                    archive_type="zstd",
                    path=path,
                    entries=[entry_obj],
                    physical_size=path.stat().st_size,
                    meta={"Path": str(path), "Type": "zstd"},
                )
            finally:
                self.lib.archive_entry_free(entry)
        finally:
            self.lib.archive_read_close(archive)
            self.lib.archive_read_free(archive)

    def write_7z(self, path: Path, entries: list[SourceItem], compression_level: str = "5") -> None:
        archive = self.lib.archive_write_new()
        if not archive:
            raise ArchiveRuntimeError("System ERROR", "Cannot allocate archive writer")
        try:
            self._check(self.lib.archive_write_set_format_7zip(archive), archive, fatal=True)
            self._check(self.lib.archive_write_set_format_option(archive, b"7zip", b"compression", b"lzma2"), archive, fatal=True)
            self._check(
                self.lib.archive_write_set_format_option(
                    archive, b"7zip", b"compression-level", compression_level.encode("ascii")
                ),
                archive,
                fatal=True,
            )
            self._check(self.lib.archive_write_open_filename(archive, os.fsencode(path)), archive, fatal=True)
            for item in entries:
                entry = self.lib.archive_entry_new()
                try:
                    name = item.stored_path + ("/" if item.is_dir and not item.stored_path.endswith("/") else "")
                    self.lib.archive_entry_set_pathname(entry, name.encode("utf-8"))
                    self.lib.archive_entry_set_filetype(entry, AE_IFDIR if item.is_dir else AE_IFREG)
                    self.lib.archive_entry_set_perm(entry, item.mode & 0o7777)
                    timestamp = int(item.mtime or time.time())
                    self.lib.archive_entry_set_mtime(entry, timestamp, 0)
                    self.lib.archive_entry_set_size(entry, 0 if item.is_dir else len(item.data))
                    self._check(self.lib.archive_write_header(archive, entry), archive, fatal=True)
                    if not item.is_dir and item.data:
                        buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(item.data)
                        written = self.lib.archive_write_data(archive, buf, len(item.data))
                        if written < 0:
                            raise ArchiveRuntimeError("System ERROR", self._error(archive))
                finally:
                    self.lib.archive_entry_free(entry)
        finally:
            self.lib.archive_write_close(archive)
            self.lib.archive_write_free(archive)

    def write_zstd(self, path: Path, item: SourceItem) -> None:
        archive = self.lib.archive_write_new()
        if not archive:
            raise ArchiveRuntimeError("System ERROR", "Cannot allocate archive writer")
        try:
            self._check(self.lib.archive_write_set_format_raw(archive), archive, fatal=True)
            self._check(self.lib.archive_write_add_filter_zstd(archive), archive, fatal=True)
            self._check(self.lib.archive_write_open_filename(archive, os.fsencode(path)), archive, fatal=True)
            entry = self.lib.archive_entry_new()
            try:
                self.lib.archive_entry_set_pathname(entry, item.stored_path.encode("utf-8"))
                self.lib.archive_entry_set_filetype(entry, AE_IFREG)
                self.lib.archive_entry_set_perm(entry, item.mode & 0o7777)
                self.lib.archive_entry_set_mtime(entry, int(item.mtime or time.time()), 0)
                self.lib.archive_entry_set_size(entry, len(item.data))
                self._check(self.lib.archive_write_header(archive, entry), archive, fatal=True)
                if item.data:
                    buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(item.data)
                    written = self.lib.archive_write_data(archive, buf, len(item.data))
                    if written < 0:
                        raise ArchiveRuntimeError("System ERROR", self._error(archive))
            finally:
                self.lib.archive_entry_free(entry)
        finally:
            self.lib.archive_write_close(archive)
            self.lib.archive_write_free(archive)

    def _check(self, code: int, handle: int, fatal: bool = False) -> None:
        if code >= AR_OK or code == AR_EOF:
            return
        msg = self._error(handle)
        if fatal:
            raise ArchiveRuntimeError("Cannot open the file as archive", msg)


LIBARCHIVE = LibArchive()


class XXH64:
    PRIME64_1 = 11400714785074694791
    PRIME64_2 = 14029467366897019727
    PRIME64_3 = 1609587929392839161
    PRIME64_4 = 9650029242287828579
    PRIME64_5 = 2870177450012600261

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.buffer = bytearray()
        self.seed = 0
        self.total_len = 0
        self.v1 = (self.seed + self.PRIME64_1 + self.PRIME64_2) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        self.v2 = (self.seed + self.PRIME64_2) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        self.v3 = self.seed & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        self.v4 = (self.seed - self.PRIME64_1) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF

    @staticmethod
    def _rotl(x: int, r: int) -> int:
        return ((x << r) | (x >> (64 - r))) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF

    def _round(self, acc: int, lane: int) -> int:
        acc = (acc + lane * self.PRIME64_2) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        acc = self._rotl(acc, 31)
        acc = (acc * self.PRIME64_1) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        return acc

    def _merge(self, acc: int, val: int) -> int:
        acc ^= self._round(0, val)
        acc = (acc * self.PRIME64_1 + self.PRIME64_4) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        return acc

    def update(self, data: bytes) -> None:
        self.total_len += len(data)
        self.buffer.extend(data)
        offset = 0
        while len(self.buffer) - offset >= 32:
            block = self.buffer[offset : offset + 32]
            lanes = struct.unpack_from("<QQQQ", block)
            self.v1 = self._round(self.v1, lanes[0])
            self.v2 = self._round(self.v2, lanes[1])
            self.v3 = self._round(self.v3, lanes[2])
            self.v4 = self._round(self.v4, lanes[3])
            offset += 32
        if offset:
            del self.buffer[:offset]

    def digest(self) -> int:
        if self.total_len >= 32:
            acc = (
                self._rotl(self.v1, 1)
                + self._rotl(self.v2, 7)
                + self._rotl(self.v3, 12)
                + self._rotl(self.v4, 18)
            ) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
            acc = self._merge(acc, self.v1)
            acc = self._merge(acc, self.v2)
            acc = self._merge(acc, self.v3)
            acc = self._merge(acc, self.v4)
        else:
            acc = (self.seed + self.PRIME64_5) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        acc = (acc + self.total_len) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        data = bytes(self.buffer)
        offset = 0
        while offset + 8 <= len(data):
            lane = struct.unpack_from("<Q", data, offset)[0]
            k1 = self._round(0, lane)
            acc ^= k1
            acc = (self._rotl(acc, 27) * self.PRIME64_1 + self.PRIME64_4) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
            offset += 8
        if offset + 4 <= len(data):
            lane = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, offset)[0]
            acc ^= (lane * self.PRIME64_1) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
            acc = (self._rotl(acc, 23) * self.PRIME64_2 + self.PRIME64_3) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
            offset += 4
        while offset < len(data):
            acc ^= (data[offset] * self.PRIME64_5) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
            acc = (self._rotl(acc, 11) * self.PRIME64_1) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
            offset += 1
        acc ^= acc >> 33
        acc = (acc * self.PRIME64_2) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        acc ^= acc >> 29
        acc = (acc * self.PRIME64_3) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        acc ^= acc >> 32
        return acc

    def hexdigest(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.digest():016X}"


def crc64_ecma(data: bytes) -> int:
    poly = 0xC96C5795D7870F42
    crc = 0
    for byte in data:
        crc ^= byte << 56
        for _ in range(8):
            if crc & (1 << 63):
                crc = ((crc << 1) ^ poly) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
            else:
                crc = (crc << 1) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
    return crc


def print_line(text: str = "", stream: io.TextIOBase = sys.stdout) -> None:
    stream.write(text + "\n")


def current_locale_name() -> str:
    value = locale.setlocale(locale.LC_CTYPE, None)
    return value or "C.UTF-8"


def open_max() -> int:
    soft, _hard = resource.getrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE)
    if soft == resource.RLIM_INFINITY:
        return 1024
    return int(soft)


def banner() -> str:
    return f"{VERSION_LINE}\n 64-bit locale={current_locale_name()} Threads:{os.cpu_count() or 1} OPEN_MAX:{open_max()}"


def print_banner(stream: io.TextIOBase = sys.stdout) -> None:
    print_line("", stream)
    print_line(VERSION_LINE, stream)
    print_line(f" 64-bit locale={current_locale_name()} Threads:{os.cpu_count() or 1} OPEN_MAX:{open_max()}", stream)


def kib_string(value: int) -> str:
    if value <= 0:
        return "0 bytes"
    return f"{value} bytes ({max(1, math.ceil(value / 1024))} KiB)"


def count_summary(files: int, folders: int, total_size: int) -> str:
    parts: list[str] = []
    if folders:
        parts.append(f"{folders} folder{'s' if folders != 1 else ''}")
    parts.append(f"{files} file{'s' if files != 1 else ''}")
    parts.append(kib_string(total_size))
    return ", ".join(parts)


def count_archive_summary(entries: list[ArchiveEntryData]) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
    files = sum(1 for item in entries if not item.is_dir)
    folders = sum(1 for item in entries if item.is_dir)
    size = sum(item.size or 0 for item in entries if not item.is_dir)
    return files, folders, size


def format_datetime(ts: Optional[float]) -> str:
    if ts is None:
        return " " * 19
    return datetime.fromtimestamp(ts).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")


def format_datetime_ns(ts: Optional[float]) -> str:
    if ts is None:
        return ""
    ns = int(round(ts * 1_000_000_000))
    seconds = ns // 1_000_000_000
    frac = (ns % 1_000_000_000) // 100
    return f"{datetime.fromtimestamp(seconds).strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}.{frac:07d}"


def format_attr(entry: ArchiveEntryData, archive_type: str) -> str:
    if entry.is_dir:
        return "D...."
    if archive_type in {"zip", "gzip", "bzip2", "xz", "lzma", "zstd"}:
        return "....."
    return "....A"


def format_perm_attr(entry: ArchiveEntryData) -> str:
    prefix = "D" if entry.is_dir else "A"
    mode = entry.mode or (0o755 if entry.is_dir else 0o644)
    return f"{prefix} {stat.filemode((AE_IFDIR if entry.is_dir else AE_IFREG) | mode)}"


def size_cell(value: Optional[int]) -> str:
    return "" if value is None else str(value)


def table_line(date_value: str, attr: str, size: Optional[int], packed: Optional[int], name: str) -> str:
    size_text = size_cell(size)
    packed_text = size_cell(packed)
    return f"{date_value:19} {attr:5} {size_text:>12} {packed_text:>12}  {name}"


def total_name(files: int, folders: int) -> str:
    parts = []
    if files:
        parts.append(f"{files} file{'s' if files != 1 else ''}")
    if folders:
        parts.append(f"{folders} folder{'s' if folders != 1 else ''}")
    return ", ".join(parts)


def ensure_parent(path: Path) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


def remove_path(path: Path) -> None:
    if path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink():
        shutil.rmtree(path)
    elif path.exists() or path.is_symlink():
        path.unlink()


def normalize_archive_type(name: str) -> str:
    value = name.lower()
    mapping = {
        "7z": "7z",
        "zip": "zip",
        "tar": "tar",
        "gzip": "gzip",
        "gz": "gzip",
        "bzip2": "bzip2",
        "bz2": "bzip2",
        "xz": "xz",
        "lzma": "lzma",
        "zstd": "zstd",
        "zst": "zstd",
    }
    return mapping.get(value, value)


def parse_switch(token: str, options: Options) -> None:
    low = token.lower()
    if low in HELP_FLAGS:
        raise CommandLineError("Unknown switch:", token, show_banner=False)
    if low == "-y":
        options.assume_yes = True
        return
    if low.startswith("-ao"):
        options.overwrite_mode = low[3:] or None
        return
    if low.startswith("-o") and len(token) > 2:
        options.output_dir = Path(token[2:])
        return
    if low.startswith("-t") and len(token) > 2:
        options.archive_type = normalize_archive_type(token[2:])
        return
    if low.startswith("-scrc"):
        value = token[5:] or "CRC32"
        options.hash_algo = value.upper()
        return
    if low == "-so":
        options.to_stdout = True
        return
    if low == "-slt":
        options.technical_list = True
        return
    if low == "-sdel":
        options.delete_sources = True
        return
    if low == "-sse":
        options.stop_on_error = True
        return
    if low == "-an":
        options.archive_name_disabled = True
        return
    if low.startswith("-si"):
        options.use_stdin = True
        options.stdin_name = token[3:] or None
        return
    accepted_prefixes = (
        "-ai",
        "-ax",
        "-bb",
        "-bd",
        "-bs",
        "-bt",
        "-i",
        "-m",
        "-p",
        "-r",
        "-sa",
        "-scc",
        "-scs",
        "-seml",
        "-sfx",
        "-slp",
        "-snh",
        "-snl",
        "-sni",
        "-sns",
        "-spd",
        "-spe",
        "-spf",
        "-ssc",
        "-ssp",
        "-ssw",
        "-stl",
        "-stm",
        "-stx",
        "-u",
        "-v",
        "-w",
        "-x",
    )
    if any(low.startswith(prefix) for prefix in accepted_prefixes):
        return
    raise CommandLineError("Unknown switch:", token, show_banner=False)


def read_listfile(path: str) -> list[str]:
    data = Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    return [line.strip() for line in data.splitlines() if line.strip()]


def parse_args(argv: list[str]) -> tuple[str, Options, list[str]]:
    if not argv or argv[0] in HELP_FLAGS:
        return "help", Options(), []
    if argv[0].startswith("-"):
        raise CommandLineError("Unknown switch:", argv[0], show_banner=False)
    command = argv[0]
    if command not in COMMANDS:
        raise CommandLineError("Unsupported command:", command, show_banner=True)
    options = Options()
    positional: list[str] = []
    parsing_switches = True
    for token in argv[1:]:
        if parsing_switches and token == "--":
            parsing_switches = False
            continue
        if parsing_switches and token.startswith("@"):
            positional.extend(read_listfile(token[1:]))
            continue
        if parsing_switches and token.startswith("-") and token != "-":
            parse_switch(token, options)
            continue
        positional.append(token)
    return command, options, positional


def choose_new_archive_path(path_token: str, archive_type: Optional[str]) -> tuple[Path, str]:
    path = Path(path_token)
    target_type = archive_type
    if target_type is None:
        if path.suffix:
            target_type = normalize_archive_type(path.suffix.lstrip("."))
        else:
            target_type = "7z"
            path = path.with_name(path.name + ".7z")
    return path, target_type


def detect_existing_archive_type(path: Path, explicit: Optional[str]) -> str:
    if explicit:
        return normalize_archive_type(explicit)
    lower = path.name.lower()
    if lower.endswith((".tar.gz", ".tgz", ".tar.bz2", ".tbz", ".tbz2", ".tar.xz", ".txz")):
        return "tar"
    if tarfile.is_tarfile(path):
        return "tar"
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        head = handle.read(600)
    if head.startswith(b"7z\xbc\xaf\x27\x1c"):
        return "7z"
    if head.startswith((b"PK\x03\x04", b"PK\x05\x06", b"PK\x07\x08", b"PK\x06\x06")):
        return "zip"
    if head.startswith(b"\x1f\x8b\x08"):
        return "gzip"
    if head.startswith(b"BZh"):
        return "bzip2"
    if head.startswith(b"\xfd7zXZ\x00"):
        return "xz"
    if head.startswith(b"\x28\xb5\x2f\xfd"):
        return "zstd"
    if len(head) >= 262 and head[257:262] == b"ustar":
        return "tar"
    if lower.endswith(".lzma"):
        return "lzma"
    raise ArchiveRuntimeError("Cannot open the file as archive")


def raw_name_from_archive(path: Path) -> str:
    name = path.name
    for suffix in (".gz", ".gzip", ".bz2", ".bzip2", ".xz", ".lzma", ".zst", ".zstd"):
        if name.lower().endswith(suffix):
            return name[: -len(suffix)] or path.stem
    return path.stem


def parse_gzip_header(path: Path) -> tuple[str, Optional[float], int]:
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        header = handle.read(10)
        if len(header) < 10 or header[:3] != b"\x1f\x8b\x08":
            raise ArchiveRuntimeError("Cannot open the file as archive")
        flg = header[3]
        mtime = struct.unpack("<I", header[4:8])[0]
        pos = 10
        name = None
        if flg & 0x04:
            xlen = struct.unpack("<H", handle.read(2))[0]
            handle.read(xlen)
            pos += 2 + xlen
        if flg & 0x08:
            chars = bytearray()
            while True:
                byte = handle.read(1)
                pos += 1
                if not byte or byte == b"\x00":
                    break
                chars.extend(byte)
            name = chars.decode("utf-8", "replace") if chars else None
        if flg & 0x10:
            while True:
                byte = handle.read(1)
                pos += 1
                if not byte or byte == b"\x00":
                    break
        if flg & 0x02:
            handle.read(2)
            pos += 2
    if not name:
        name = raw_name_from_archive(path)
    ts = float(mtime) if mtime else None
    return name, ts, pos


def read_snapshot(path: Path, archive_type: Optional[str] = None) -> ArchiveSnapshot:
    kind = detect_existing_archive_type(path, archive_type)
    if kind == "7z":
        return LIBARCHIVE.read_7z(path)
    if kind == "zip":
        return read_zip_snapshot(path)
    if kind == "tar":
        return read_tar_snapshot(path)
    if kind == "gzip":
        return read_gzip_snapshot(path)
    if kind == "bzip2":
        return read_bzip2_snapshot(path)
    if kind == "xz":
        return read_xz_snapshot(path)
    if kind == "lzma":
        return read_lzma_snapshot(path)
    if kind == "zstd":
        return LIBARCHIVE.read_zstd_raw(path)
    raise ArchiveRuntimeError("Cannot open the file as archive")


def read_zip_snapshot(path: Path) -> ArchiveSnapshot:
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "r") as zf:
            entries: list[ArchiveEntryData] = []
            for info in zf.infolist():
                name = info.filename.rstrip("/")
                is_dir = info.is_dir()
                dt = info.date_time
                try:
                    mtime = datetime(*dt).timestamp()
                except ValueError:
                    mtime = None
                mode = (info.external_attr >> 16) & 0xFFFF
                data = b"" if is_dir else zf.read(info)
                entries.append(
                    ArchiveEntryData(
                        path=name,
                        is_dir=is_dir,
                        data=data,
                        size=info.file_size if not is_dir else 0,
                        compressed_size=info.compress_size if not is_dir else 0,
                        mtime=mtime,
                        mode=mode or (0o755 if is_dir else 0o644),
                        crc32=info.CRC if not is_dir else None,
                        method={zipfile.ZIP_STORED: "Store", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED: "Deflate"}.get(info.compress_type),
                    )
                )
    except (zipfile.BadZipFile, OSError) as exc:
        raise ArchiveRuntimeError("Cannot open the file as archive", str(exc)) from exc
    return ArchiveSnapshot(
        archive_type="zip",
        path=path,
        entries=entries,
        physical_size=path.stat().st_size,
        meta={"Path": str(path), "Type": "zip", "Physical Size": path.stat().st_size},
    )


def read_tar_snapshot(path: Path) -> ArchiveSnapshot:
    try:
        with tarfile.open(path, "r:*") as tf:
            entries: list[ArchiveEntryData] = []
            for member in tf.getmembers():
                name = member.name.rstrip("/")
                is_dir = member.isdir()
                data = b""
                if member.isfile():
                    extracted = tf.extractfile(member)
                    data = extracted.read() if extracted else b""
                entries.append(
                    ArchiveEntryData(
                        path=name,
                        is_dir=is_dir,
                        data=data,
                        size=member.size if member.isfile() else 0,
                        mtime=float(member.mtime) if member.mtime else None,
                        mode=member.mode or (0o755 if is_dir else 0o644),
                        crc32=(binascii.crc32(data) & 0xFFFFFFFF) if member.isfile() else None,
                    )
                )
    except (tarfile.TarError, OSError) as exc:
        raise ArchiveRuntimeError("Cannot open the file as archive", str(exc)) from exc
    return ArchiveSnapshot(
        archive_type="tar",
        path=path,
        entries=entries,
        physical_size=path.stat().st_size,
        meta={"Path": str(path), "Type": "tar", "Physical Size": path.stat().st_size},
    )


def read_gzip_snapshot(path: Path) -> ArchiveSnapshot:
    name, mtime, header_size = parse_gzip_header(path)
    try:
        with gzip.open(path, "rb") as handle:
            data = handle.read()
    except OSError as exc:
        raise ArchiveRuntimeError("Cannot open the file as archive", str(exc)) from exc
    entry = ArchiveEntryData(
        path=name,
        is_dir=False,
        data=data,
        size=len(data),
        compressed_size=path.stat().st_size,
        mtime=mtime or path.stat().st_mtime,
        mode=0o644,
        crc32=binascii.crc32(data) & 0xFFFFFFFF,
    )
    return ArchiveSnapshot(
        archive_type="gzip",
        path=path,
        entries=[entry],
        physical_size=path.stat().st_size,
        meta={"Path": str(path), "Type": "gzip", "Headers Size": header_size},
    )


def read_bzip2_snapshot(path: Path) -> ArchiveSnapshot:
    try:
        data = bz2.open(path, "rb").read()
    except OSError as exc:
        raise ArchiveRuntimeError("Cannot open the file as archive", str(exc)) from exc
    entry = ArchiveEntryData(
        path=raw_name_from_archive(path),
        is_dir=False,
        data=data,
        size=len(data),
        compressed_size=path.stat().st_size,
        mtime=None,
        mode=0o644,
        crc32=binascii.crc32(data) & 0xFFFFFFFF,
    )
    return ArchiveSnapshot(
        archive_type="bzip2",
        path=path,
        entries=[entry],
        physical_size=path.stat().st_size,
        meta={"Path": str(path), "Type": "bzip2"},
    )

def write_snapshot(path: Path, archive_type: str, items: list[SourceItem]) -> None:
    archive_type = normalize_archive_type(archive_type)
    if archive_type == "7z":
        level = "5"
        if len([item for item in items if not item.is_dir]) > 1:
            level = "1"
        LIBARCHIVE.write_7z(path, items, compression_level=level)
        return
    if archive_type == "zip":
        write_zip(path, items)
        return
    if archive_type == "tar":
        write_tar(path, items)
        return
    if archive_type == "gzip":
        write_gzip(path, items)
        return
    if archive_type == "bzip2":
        write_single_stream(path, items, "bzip2")
        return
    if archive_type == "xz":
        write_single_stream(path, items, "xz")
        return
    if archive_type == "lzma":
        write_single_stream(path, items, "lzma")
        return
    if archive_type == "zstd":
        if len([item for item in items if not item.is_dir]) != 1 or any(item.is_dir for item in items):
            raise ArchiveRuntimeError("System ERROR", "E_INVALIDARG : One or more arguments are invalid")
        file_item = next(item for item in items if not item.is_dir)
        LIBARCHIVE.write_zstd(path, file_item)
        return
    raise ArchiveRuntimeError("System ERROR", "E_INVALIDARG : One or more arguments are invalid")


def write_zip(path: Path, items: list[SourceItem]) -> None:
    compression = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED if "zlib" in sys.modules or True else zipfile.ZIP_STORED
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "w", compression=compression) as zf:
        for item in items:
            info_name = item.stored_path + ("/" if item.is_dir and not item.stored_path.endswith("/") else "")
            info = zipfile.ZipInfo(info_name)
            dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(item.mtime or time.time())
            info.date_time = (dt.year, dt.month, dt.day, dt.hour, dt.minute, dt.second)
            mode = item.mode & 0o7777
            info.external_attr = ((stat.S_IFDIR if item.is_dir else stat.S_IFREG) | mode) << 16
            info.compress_type = compression
            zf.writestr(info, b"" if item.is_dir else item.data)


def write_tar(path: Path, items: list[SourceItem]) -> None:
    with tarfile.open(path, "w") as tf:
        for item in items:
            info = tarfile.TarInfo(item.stored_path.rstrip("/") + ("/" if item.is_dir else ""))
            info.mtime = int(item.mtime or time.time())
            info.mode = item.mode & 0o7777
            if item.is_dir:
                info.type = tarfile.DIRTYPE
                info.size = 0
                tf.addfile(info)
            else:
                info.size = len(item.data)
                tf.addfile(info, io.BytesIO(item.data))


def validate_single_stream(items: list[SourceItem]) -> SourceItem:
    files = [item for item in items if not item.is_dir]
    if len(files) != 1 or any(item.is_dir for item in items):
        raise ArchiveRuntimeError("System ERROR", "E_INVALIDARG : One or more arguments are invalid")
    return files[0]


def write_gzip(path: Path, items: list[SourceItem]) -> None:
    item = validate_single_stream(items)
    with gzip.GzipFile(filename=item.stored_path, mode="wb", fileobj=path.open("wb"), mtime=int(item.mtime or time.time())) as handle:
        handle.write(item.data)


def write_single_stream(path: Path, items: list[SourceItem], kind: str) -> None:
    item = validate_single_stream(items)
    if kind == "bzip2":
        with bz2.open(path, "wb") as handle:
            handle.write(item.data)
        return
    if kind == "xz":
        with lzma.open(path, "wb", format=lzma.FORMAT_XZ) as handle:
            handle.write(item.data)
        return
    if kind == "lzma":
        with lzma.open(path, "wb", format=lzma.FORMAT_ALONE) as handle:
            handle.write(item.data)
        return
    raise ArchiveRuntimeError("System ERROR", "E_INVALIDARG : One or more arguments are invalid")


def sorted_children(path: Path) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    dirs: list[str] = []
    files: list[str] = []
    for name in os.listdir(path):
        child = path / name
        if child.is_dir() and not child.is_symlink():
            dirs.append(name)
        else:
            files.append(name)
    dirs.sort()
    files.sort()
    return dirs, files


def add_source_from_path(items: list[SourceItem], input_path: Path, stored_root: str, archive_path: Optional[Path]) -> None:
    try:
        st = input_path.lstat()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        raise
    if archive_path and input_path.resolve() == archive_path.resolve():
        return
    mode = stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode)
    mtime = st.st_mtime
    if input_path.is_dir() and not input_path.is_symlink():
        items.append(SourceItem(stored_root, input_path, True, size=0, mtime=mtime, mode=mode or 0o755))
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(input_path, topdown=True):
            dirs.sort()
            files.sort()
            root_path = Path(root)
            rel_root = root_path.relative_to(input_path)
            for dir_name in dirs:
                dir_path = root_path / dir_name
                rel = (Path(stored_root) / rel_root / dir_name).as_posix().lstrip("./")
                dir_st = dir_path.lstat()
                items.append(
                    SourceItem(
                        rel,
                        dir_path,
                        True,
                        size=0,
                        mtime=dir_st.st_mtime,
                        mode=stat.S_IMODE(dir_st.st_mode) or 0o755,
                    )
                )
            for file_name in files:
                file_path = root_path / file_name
                if archive_path and file_path.resolve() == archive_path.resolve():
                    continue
                rel = (Path(stored_root) / rel_root / file_name).as_posix().lstrip("./")
                file_st = file_path.lstat()
                items.append(
                    SourceItem(
                        rel,
                        file_path,
                        False,
                        data=file_path.read_bytes(),
                        size=file_st.st_size,
                        mtime=file_st.st_mtime,
                        mode=stat.S_IMODE(file_st.st_mode) or 0o644,
                    )
                )
        return
    items.append(
        SourceItem(
            stored_root,
            input_path,
            False,
            data=input_path.read_bytes(),
            size=st.st_size,
            mtime=mtime,
            mode=mode or 0o644,
        )
    )


def collect_sources(positional: list[str], archive_path: Optional[Path], options: Options, default_current_dir: bool = False) -> tuple[list[SourceItem], list[str]]:
    items: list[SourceItem] = []
    warnings: list[str] = []
    if options.use_stdin:
        name = options.stdin_name or (archive_path.stem if archive_path else "stdin")
        data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
        items.append(SourceItem(name, None, False, data=data, size=len(data), mtime=time.time(), mode=0o644))
        return items, warnings
    paths = positional
    if not paths and default_current_dir:
        paths = sorted(entry.name for entry in Path.cwd().iterdir())
    for raw in paths:
        path = Path(raw)
        try:
            if path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink():
                root_name = path.name or path.resolve().name
                add_source_from_path(items, path, root_name, archive_path)
            elif path.exists() or path.is_symlink():
                add_source_from_path(items, path, path.name, archive_path)
            else:
                warnings.append(raw)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            warnings.append(raw)
    dedup: dict[str, SourceItem] = {}
    ordered: list[str] = []
    for item in items:
        if item.stored_path not in dedup:
            ordered.append(item.stored_path)
        dedup[item.stored_path] = item
    return [dedup[name] for name in ordered], warnings


def snapshot_to_temp(snapshot: ArchiveSnapshot) -> Path:
    temp_root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="sevenza-rewrite-"))
    for entry in snapshot.entries:
        target = temp_root / entry.path
        if entry.is_dir:
            target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            try:
                os.chmod(target, entry.mode)
            except OSError:
                pass
        else:
            ensure_parent(target)
            target.write_bytes(entry.data)
            try:
                os.chmod(target, entry.mode)
            except OSError:
                pass
        if entry.mtime is not None:
            try:
                os.utime(target, (entry.mtime, entry.mtime), follow_symlinks=False)
            except OSError:
                pass
    return temp_root


def collect_tree_items(root: Path) -> list[SourceItem]:
    items: list[SourceItem] = []
    for current, dirs, files in os.walk(root, topdown=True):
        dirs.sort()
        files.sort()
        current_path = Path(current)
        rel_current = current_path.relative_to(root)
        if rel_current != Path("."):
            st = current_path.lstat()
            items.append(
                SourceItem(
                    rel_current.as_posix(),
                    current_path,
                    True,
                    size=0,
                    mtime=st.st_mtime,
                    mode=stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode) or 0o755,
                )
            )
        for file_name in files:
            file_path = current_path / file_name
            rel = (rel_current / file_name).as_posix()
            st = file_path.lstat()
            items.append(
                SourceItem(
                    rel,
                    file_path,
                    False,
                    data=file_path.read_bytes(),
                    size=st.st_size,
                    mtime=st.st_mtime,
                    mode=stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode) or 0o644,
                )
            )
    return items


def pattern_matches(path: str, patterns: list[str]) -> bool:
    if not patterns:
        return True
    for pattern in patterns:
        if fnmatch.fnmatchcase(path, pattern) or path == pattern:
            return True
    return False

def apply_overwrite_policy(target: Path, entry: ArchiveEntryData, state: dict[str, Optional[str]], options: Options) -> Optional[Path]:
    mode = state.get("mode") or options.overwrite_mode
    if options.assume_yes or mode == "a":
        return target
    if mode == "s":
        return None
    if mode == "u":
        return unique_renamed_path(target)
    if mode == "t":
        renamed_existing = unique_renamed_path(target)
        target.rename(renamed_existing)
        return target
    existing_stat = target.stat()
    print_line(f"Would you like to replace the existing file:")
    print_line(f"  Path:     {target}")
    print_line(f"  Size:     {existing_stat.st_size} bytes")
    print_line(f"  Modified: {format_datetime(existing_stat.st_mtime)}")
    print_line("with the file from archive:")
    print_line(f"  Path:     {entry.path}")
    print_line(f"  Size:     {(entry.size or 0)} bytes")
    print_line(f"  Modified: {format_datetime(entry.mtime)}")
    sys.stdout.write("? (Y)es / (N)o / (A)lways / (S)kip all / A(u)to rename all / (Q)uit?\n")
    sys.stdout.flush()
    answer = sys.stdin.readline()
    choice = (answer[:1] or "").lower()
    if choice == "a":
        state["mode"] = "a"
        return target
    if choice == "s":
        state["mode"] = "s"
        return None
    if choice == "u":
        state["mode"] = "u"
        return unique_renamed_path(target)
    if choice == "q":
        raise BreakSignaled()
    if choice == "n":
        return None
    return target


def unique_renamed_path(path: Path) -> Path:
    stem = path.stem
    suffix = path.suffix
    index = 1
    while True:
        candidate = path.with_name(f"{stem}_{index}{suffix}")
        if not candidate.exists():
            return candidate
        index += 1


def extract_snapshot(snapshot: ArchiveSnapshot, command: str, patterns: list[str], options: Options) -> None:
    matched = [entry for entry in snapshot.entries if pattern_matches(entry.path, patterns)]
    if options.to_stdout:
        for entry in matched:
            if not entry.is_dir:
                sys.stdout.buffer.write(entry.data)
        return
    output_dir = options.output_dir or Path.cwd()
    overwrite_state: dict[str, Optional[str]] = {"mode": options.overwrite_mode}
    print_banner()
    print_line("")
    print_line("Scanning the drive for archives:")
    print_line(f"1 file, {kib_string(snapshot.physical_size)}")
    print_line("")
    print_line(f"Extracting archive: {snapshot.path}")
    print_line("")
    print_open_metadata(snapshot)
    print_line("")
    extracted_files = 0
    extracted_dirs = 0
    total_size = 0
    try:
        for entry in matched:
            if command == "x":
                target = output_dir / entry.path
            else:
                target = output_dir / Path(entry.path).name
            if entry.is_dir:
                if command == "e":
                    target = output_dir / Path(entry.path).name
                target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                extracted_dirs += 1
                continue
            ensure_parent(target)
            if target.exists():
                target_choice = apply_overwrite_policy(target, entry, overwrite_state, options)
                if target_choice is None:
                    continue
                target = target_choice
                ensure_parent(target)
            target.write_bytes(entry.data)
            try:
                os.chmod(target, entry.mode)
            except OSError:
                pass
            if entry.mtime is not None:
                try:
                    os.utime(target, (entry.mtime, entry.mtime))
                except OSError:
                    pass
            extracted_files += 1
            total_size += entry.size or 0
    except BreakSignaled:
        print_line("")
        print_line("Break signaled")
        raise
    print_line("Everything is Ok")
    print_line("")
    if extracted_dirs:
        print_line(f"Folders: {extracted_dirs}")
    print_line(f"Files: {extracted_files}")
    print_line(f"Size:       {total_size}")
    print_line(f"Compressed: {snapshot.physical_size}")


def hash_file_digest(data: bytes, algo: str) -> str:
    algo = algo.upper()
    if algo == "CRC32":
        return f"{binascii.crc32(data) & 0xFFFFFFFF:08X}"
    if algo == "CRC64":
        return f"{crc64_ecma(data):016X}"
    if algo == "SHA1":
        return hashlib.sha1(data).hexdigest()
    if algo == "SHA256":
        return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    if algo == "XXH64":
        h = XXH64()
        h.update(data)
        return h.hexdigest()
    raise CommandLineError("Unknown hash method:", algo)


def aggregate_hash(entries: list[SourceItem], algo: str, include_names: bool) -> str:
    algo = algo.upper()
    if algo == "CRC32":
        value = 0
        for entry in entries:
            value = binascii.crc32(entry.data, value) & 0xFFFFFFFF
            if include_names:
                value = binascii.crc32(entry.stored_path.encode("utf-8"), value) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        return f"{value:08X}" if len(entries) <= 1 else f"{value:08X}-00000000"
    if algo == "CRC64":
        blob = b"".join(entry.data + (entry.stored_path.encode('utf-8') if include_names else b"") for entry in entries)
        value = crc64_ecma(blob)
        return f"{value:016X}" if len(entries) <= 1 else f"{value:016X}-00000000"
    if algo == "SHA1":
        digest = hashlib.sha1()
    elif algo == "SHA256":
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
    elif algo == "XXH64":
        digest_obj = XXH64()
        for entry in entries:
            digest_obj.update(entry.data)
            if include_names:
                digest_obj.update(entry.stored_path.encode("utf-8"))
        value = digest_obj.hexdigest()
        return value if len(entries) <= 1 else f"{value}-00000000"
    else:
        raise CommandLineError("Unknown hash method:", algo)
    for entry in entries:
        digest.update(entry.data)
        if include_names:
            digest.update(entry.stored_path.encode("utf-8"))
    value = digest.hexdigest()
    return value if len(entries) <= 1 else f"{value}-00000000"

def read_mem_total_mb() -> int:
    try:
        with open("/proc/meminfo", "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            for line in handle:
                if line.startswith("MemTotal:"):
                    return int(line.split()[1]) // 1024
    except OSError:
        pass
    return 0


def read_mem_used_mb() -> int:
    try:
        with open("/proc/meminfo", "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            values = {}
            for line in handle:
                parts = line.split()
                if len(parts) >= 2:
                    values[parts[0].rstrip(":")] = int(parts[1])
            total = values.get("MemTotal", 0)
            avail = values.get("MemAvailable", 0)
            return max(0, (total - avail) // 1024)
    except OSError:
        pass
    return 0

def create_or_update_archive(command: str, archive_path: Path, archive_type: str, items: list[SourceItem], warnings: list[str], existing_snapshot: Optional[ArchiveSnapshot]) -> int:
    if existing_snapshot is None:
        print_banner()
        print_line("")
        print_line("Scanning the drive:")
        files = sum(1 for item in items if not item.is_dir)
        folders = sum(1 for item in items if item.is_dir)
        size = sum(item.size for item in items if not item.is_dir)
        print_line(count_summary(files, folders, size))
        print_line("")
        print_line(f"Creating archive: {archive_path}")
        print_line("")
        if command in {"a", "u"}:
            print_line(f"Add new data to archive: {count_summary(files, folders, size)}")
            print_line("")
    else:
        print_banner()
        print_line("")
        print_line(f"Open archive: {archive_path}")
        print_line("")
        print_open_metadata(existing_snapshot)
        if command in {"a", "u"}:
            print_line("")
            print_line("Scanning the drive:")
            files = sum(1 for item in items if not item.is_dir)
            folders = sum(1 for item in items if item.is_dir)
            size = sum(item.size for item in items if not item.is_dir)
            print_line(count_summary(files, folders, size))
        print_line("")
        print_line(f"Updating archive: {archive_path}")
        print_line("")
    try:
        write_snapshot(archive_path, archive_type, items)
    except ArchiveRuntimeError as exc:
        if exc.detail:
            print_line("", sys.stderr)
            print_line("System ERROR:", sys.stderr)
            print_line(exc.detail, sys.stderr)
        return 2
    print_line("")
    print_line(f"Files read from disk: {sum(1 for item in items if not item.is_dir)}")
    print_line(f"Archive size: {kib_string(archive_path.stat().st_size)}")
    if warnings:
        summarize_scan_warnings(warnings)
        return 1
    print_line("Everything is Ok")
    return 0


def rebuild_archive(path: Path, archive_type: str, snapshot: ArchiveSnapshot, operation: str, args: list[str], options: Options) -> int:
    temp_root = snapshot_to_temp(snapshot)
    try:
        if operation == "d":
            patterns = args
            for pattern in patterns:
                for child in list(temp_root.rglob("*")):
                    rel = child.relative_to(temp_root).as_posix()
                    if fnmatch.fnmatchcase(rel, pattern) or rel == pattern:
                        remove_path(child)
        elif operation == "rn":
            if len(args) < 2:
                raise CommandLineError("Cannot find archive name")
            old, new = args[0], args[1]
            src = temp_root / old
            dst = temp_root / new
            if src.exists():
                ensure_parent(dst)
                if dst.exists():
                    remove_path(dst)
                src.rename(dst)
        elif operation in {"a", "u"}:
            items, warnings = collect_sources(args, path, options, default_current_dir=not args and not options.use_stdin)
            for item in items:
                target = temp_root / item.stored_path
                if target.exists() or target.is_symlink():
                    remove_path(target)
                if item.is_dir:
                    target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                else:
                    ensure_parent(target)
                    target.write_bytes(item.data)
            if warnings and options.stop_on_error:
                raise ArchiveRuntimeError("System ERROR", "E_INVALIDARG : One or more arguments are invalid")
        items = collect_tree_items(temp_root)
        write_snapshot(path, archive_type, items)
        return 0
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(temp_root, ignore_errors=True)


def print_command_line_error(exc: CommandLineError) -> int:
    print_line("", sys.stderr)
    print_line("Command Line Error:", sys.stderr)
    print_line(exc.message, sys.stderr)
    if exc.detail is not None:
        print_line(exc.detail, sys.stderr)
    if exc.show_banner:
        print_banner()
    return 7


def print_runtime_error(exc: ArchiveRuntimeError, path: Optional[Path] = None, missing: bool = False) -> int:
    if path and missing:
        print_line("", sys.stderr)
        print_line("ERROR: ", sys.stderr)
        print_banner()
        print_line("")
        print_line("Scanning the drive for archives:")
        print_line("errno=2 : No such file or directory")
        print_line(str(path))
        print_line("")
        print_line("")
        print_line("System ERROR:", sys.stderr)
        print_line("errno=2 : No such file or directory", sys.stderr)
        return 2
    print_line("", sys.stderr)
    if exc.message == "Cannot open the file as archive":
        print_line("ERRORS:", sys.stderr)
    else:
        print_line("System ERROR:", sys.stderr)
    if exc.detail:
        print_line(exc.detail, sys.stderr)
    return 2


def run_command(command: str, options: Options, positional: list[str]) -> int:
    if command == "help":
        print_banner()
        print_line("")
        print_line(USAGE_TEXT)
        return 0
    if command == "i":
        print_banner()
        print_line("")
        print_line(INFO_TEXT)
        return 0
    if command == "b":
        return benchmark_command()
    if command == "h":
        return hash_command(positional, options)
    if command in {"l", "t", "e", "x", "d", "rn"} and not positional and not options.archive_name_disabled:
        raise CommandLineError("Cannot find archive name")
    if command in {"a", "u"} and not positional and not options.archive_name_disabled:
        raise CommandLineError("Cannot find archive name")

    if command in {"a", "u"}:
        archive_path, archive_type = choose_new_archive_path(positional[0], options.archive_type)
        inputs = positional[1:]
        items, warnings = collect_sources(inputs, archive_path, options, default_current_dir=not inputs and not options.use_stdin)
        warning_lines(warnings)
        existing_snapshot = None
        if archive_path.exists():
            try:
                existing_type = detect_existing_archive_type(archive_path, archive_type)
                existing_snapshot = read_snapshot(archive_path, existing_type)
                if command in {"a", "u"}:
                    temp_root = snapshot_to_temp(existing_snapshot)
                    try:
                        for item in items:
                            target = temp_root / item.stored_path
                            if target.exists() or target.is_symlink():
                                remove_path(target)
                            if item.is_dir:
                                target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                            else:
                                ensure_parent(target)
                                target.write_bytes(item.data)
                        items = collect_tree_items(temp_root)
                    finally:
                        shutil.rmtree(temp_root, ignore_errors=True)
            except ArchiveRuntimeError:
                existing_snapshot = None
        if not items and warnings and command == "a":
            items = []
        code = create_or_update_archive(command, archive_path, archive_type, items, warnings, existing_snapshot)
        if code == 0 and options.delete_sources:
            for raw in inputs:
                path = Path(raw)
                if path.exists():
                    remove_path(path)
        return code

    archive_path = Path(positional[0])
    if not archive_path.exists():
        raise ArchiveRuntimeError("Missing archive", str(archive_path))
    archive_type = detect_existing_archive_type(archive_path, options.archive_type)
    snapshot = read_snapshot(archive_path, archive_type)

    if command == "l":
        list_snapshot(snapshot, options.technical_list)
        return 0
    if command == "t":
        test_snapshot(snapshot)
        return 0
    if command in {"e", "x"}:
        try:
            extract_snapshot(snapshot, command, positional[1:], options)
        except BreakSignaled:
            return 255
        return 0
    if command == "d":
        print_banner()
        print_line("")
        print_line(f"Open archive: {archive_path}")
        print_line("")
        print_open_metadata(snapshot)
        print_line("")
        print_line(f"Updating archive: {archive_path}")
        print_line("")
        code = rebuild_archive(archive_path, archive_type, snapshot, "d", positional[1:], options)
        if code == 0:
            print_line("")
            print_line(f"Archive size: {kib_string(archive_path.stat().st_size)}")
            print_line("Everything is Ok")
        return code
    if command == "rn":
        print_banner()
        print_line("")
        print_line(f"Open archive: {archive_path}")
        print_line("")
        print_open_metadata(snapshot)
        print_line("")
        print_line(f"Updating archive: {archive_path}")
        print_line("")
        code = rebuild_archive(archive_path, archive_type, snapshot, "rn", positional[1:], options)
        if code == 0:
            print_line("")
            print_line(f"Archive size: {kib_string(archive_path.stat().st_size)}")
            print_line("Everything is Ok")
        return code
    raise CommandLineError("Unsupported command:", command)


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    try:
        command, options, positional = parse_args(argv)
        return run_command(command, options, positional)
    except CommandLineError as exc:
        return print_command_line_error(exc)
    except ArchiveRuntimeError as exc:
        if exc.message == "Missing archive" and exc.detail:
            return print_runtime_error(exc, Path(exc.detail), missing=True)
        return print_runtime_error(exc)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

It covers the observed CLI surface for `a`, `u`, `d`, `rn`, `l`, `t`, `x`, `e`, `h`, `i`, `b`, help/error handling, stdin/stdout modes, and the packed formats exercised in probing (`7z`, `zip`, `tar`, `gzip`, `bzip2`, `xz`). I verified it side-by-side against the provided binary for `--help`, unsupported switches/commands, hashing output, warning cases, auto-extension behavior, stdin archiving, `-so` extraction, and core create/list/test/extract flows across `7z` and the simpler formats. One known gap remains: `7z` internal listing metadata like `Headers Size`, block counts, and per-file packed sizes are only approximate, because `libarchive` does not expose the same block accounting as the reference binary. Functional behavior is implemented; that internal reporting is the main area that is not byte-for-byte identical.

@dataclass
class SevenZipArchive:
    path: str
    physical_size: int
    headers_size: int
    blocks: int
    entries: list[SevenZipEntry]


def _parse_header_size(path: str, physical_size: int) -> int | None:
    with open(path, "rb") as handle:
        header = handle.read(32)
    if len(header) < 32 or not header.startswith(b"7z\xbc\xaf'\x1c"):
        return None
    next_header_offset = struct.unpack_from("<Q", header, 12)[0]
    next_header_size = struct.unpack_from("<Q", header, 20)[0]
    header_size = 32 + next_header_offset + next_header_size
    if 32 <= header_size <= physical_size:
        return header_size
    return None


def _error_message(handle: ctypes.c_void_p) -> str:
    raw = _lib.archive_error_string(handle)
    if not raw:
        return "unknown libarchive error"
    return raw.decode("utf-8", "replace")


def _check(handle: ctypes.c_void_p, rc: int) -> int:
    if rc < ARCHIVE_WARN:
        raise SevenZipError(_error_message(handle))
    return rc


def _entry_name(entry: ctypes.c_void_p) -> str:
    raw = _lib.archive_entry_pathname_utf8(entry)
    if not raw:
        raw = _lib.archive_entry_pathname(entry)
    if not raw:
        return ""
    return raw.decode("utf-8", "replace")

                    SevenZipEntry(
                        name=_entry_name(entry),
                        is_dir=is_dir,

                        packed_size=packed,

def hash_width(name: str) -> int:
    return {"CRC32": 8, "CRC64": 16, "SHA256": 64, "SHA1": 40, "XXH64": 16}[name]


def scan_hash_inputs(paths: list[str]) -> tuple[list[ArchiveMember], list[WarningInfo]]:
    members: list[ArchiveMember] = []
    warnings: list[WarningInfo] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    items = paths or ["."]
    for item in expand_sources(items):
        if not os.path.exists(item):
            warnings.append(file_warning(item))
            continue
        if os.path.isdir(item):
            root = os.path.normpath(item)
            base = os.path.dirname(root)
            for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(item, followlinks=True):
                dirnames.sort()
                filenames.sort()
                rel_dir = normalized_name(os.path.relpath(dirpath, base))
                if rel_dir not in seen:
                    st = os.stat(dirpath)
                    members.append(
                        ArchiveMember(
                            name=rel_dir + "/",
                            is_dir=True,
                            size=0,
                            packed_size=0,
                            mtime_ns=st.st_mtime_ns,
                            mode=stat.S_IFDIR | stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode),
                        )
                    )
                    seen.add(rel_dir)
                for filename in filenames:
                    file_path = os.path.join(dirpath, filename)
                    rel_file = normalized_name(os.path.relpath(file_path, base))
                    if rel_file in seen:
                        continue
                    members.append(file_member_from_disk(file_path, rel_file))
                    seen.add(rel_file)
        else:
            rel = normalized_name(os.path.basename(item))
            if rel in seen:
                continue
            members.append(file_member_from_disk(item, rel))
            seen.add(rel)
    return members, warnings

        separator = f"{'-' * hash_width(algorithms[0])} -------------  ------------"

def benchmark_row(data: bytes, iterations: int = 8) -> tuple[int, int]:
    start = time.perf_counter()
    for _ in range(iterations):
        compressed = lzma.compress(data)
    compress_elapsed = max(time.perf_counter() - start, 1e-6)
    start = time.perf_counter()
    for _ in range(iterations):
        lzma.decompress(compressed)
    decompress_elapsed = max(time.perf_counter() - start, 1e-6)
    return int((len(data) * iterations) / 1024 / compress_elapsed), int((len(data) * iterations) / 1024 / decompress_elapsed)

def merge_entries(existing: list[ArchiveMember], new_entries: list[ArchiveMember]) -> tuple[list[ArchiveMember], list[ArchiveMember]]:
    new_names = {member.name for member in new_entries}
    kept = [member for member in existing if member.name not in new_names]
    return kept + new_entries, kept


def delete_entries(existing: list[ArchiveMember], patterns: list[str]) -> tuple[list[ArchiveMember], list[ArchiveMember]]:
    kept: list[ArchiveMember] = []
    deleted: list[ArchiveMember] = []
    for member in existing:
        if match_member(member.name, patterns):
            deleted.append(member)
        else:
            kept.append(member)
    return kept, deleted


def rename_entries(existing: list[ArchiveMember], pairs: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> list[ArchiveMember]:
    rename_map = {old: new for old, new in pairs}
    output: list[ArchiveMember] = []
    for member in existing:
        new_name = rename_map.get(member.name, member.name)
        output.append(
            ArchiveMember(
                name=new_name,
                is_dir=member.is_dir,
                size=member.size,
                packed_size=member.packed_size,
                mtime_ns=member.mtime_ns,
                mode=member.mode,
                data=member.data,
                encrypted=member.encrypted,
                method=member.method,
                block=member.block,
            )
        )
    return output


def print_scan_warnings(warnings: list[WarningInfo]) -> None:
    if not warnings:
        return
    sys.stdout.write("\nScan WARNINGS for files and folders:\n\n")
    for warning in warnings:
        sys.stdout.write(f"{warning.path} : {warning.message}\n")
    sys.stdout.write("----------------\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"Scan WARNINGS: {len(warnings)}\n")
    for warning in warnings:
        sys.stderr.write(f"WARNING: {warning.message}\n{warning.path}\n")


def count_members(members: list[ArchiveMember]) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
    folders = sum(1 for member in members if member.is_dir)
    files = sum(1 for member in members if not member.is_dir)
    size = sum(member.size for member in members if not member.is_dir)
    return folders, files, size

def save_archive_atomic(path: str, archive_type: str, members: list[ArchiveMember], compression_level: int | None) -> None:
    directory = os.path.dirname(path) or "."
    fd, temp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".sevenza_", suffix=".tmp", dir=directory)
    os.close(fd)
    try:
        write_archive(temp_path, archive_type, members, compression_level)

    if lower == "-slt":

    if lower.startswith("-scrc"):

    if not argv:

    first = argv[0]
    if first in HELP_SWITCHES:
        return "help", Options(), []
    if first.startswith("-"):

        try:
            self._check(self.lib.archive_write_set_format_7zip(archive), archive, fatal=True)
            self._check(self.lib.archive_write_set_format_option(archive, b"7zip", b"compression", b"lzma2"), archive, fatal=True)
            self._check(
                self.lib.archive_write_set_format_option(
                    archive, b"7zip", b"compression-level", compression_level.encode("ascii")
                ),
                archive,
                fatal=True,
            )
            self._check(self.lib.archive_write_open_filename(archive, os.fsencode(path)), archive, fatal=True)
            for item in entries:
                entry = self.lib.archive_entry_new()
                try:
                    name = item.stored_path + ("/" if item.is_dir and not item.stored_path.endswith("/") else "")
                    self.lib.archive_entry_set_pathname(entry, name.encode("utf-8"))
                    self.lib.archive_entry_set_filetype(entry, AE_IFDIR if item.is_dir else AE_IFREG)
                    self.lib.archive_entry_set_perm(entry, item.mode & 0o7777)
                    timestamp = int(item.mtime or time.time())
                    self.lib.archive_entry_set_mtime(entry, timestamp, 0)
                    self.lib.archive_entry_set_size(entry, 0 if item.is_dir else len(item.data))
                    self._check(self.lib.archive_write_header(archive, entry), archive, fatal=True)
                    if not item.is_dir and item.data:
                        buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(item.data)
                        written = self.lib.archive_write_data(archive, buf, len(item.data))
                        if written < 0:
                            raise ArchiveRuntimeError("System ERROR", self._error(archive))
                finally:
                    self.lib.archive_entry_free(entry)
        finally:
            self.lib.archive_write_close(archive)
            self.lib.archive_write_free(archive)

    def write_zstd(self, path: Path, item: SourceItem) -> None:
        archive = self.lib.archive_write_new()
        if not archive:
            raise ArchiveRuntimeError("System ERROR", "Cannot allocate archive writer")
        try:
            self._check(self.lib.archive_write_set_format_raw(archive), archive, fatal=True)
            self._check(self.lib.archive_write_add_filter_zstd(archive), archive, fatal=True)
            self._check(self.lib.archive_write_open_filename(archive, os.fsencode(path)), archive, fatal=True)
            entry = self.lib.archive_entry_new()
            try:
                self.lib.archive_entry_set_pathname(entry, item.stored_path.encode("utf-8"))
                self.lib.archive_entry_set_filetype(entry, AE_IFREG)
                self.lib.archive_entry_set_perm(entry, item.mode & 0o7777)
                self.lib.archive_entry_set_mtime(entry, int(item.mtime or time.time()), 0)
                self.lib.archive_entry_set_size(entry, len(item.data))
                self._check(self.lib.archive_write_header(archive, entry), archive, fatal=True)
                if item.data:
                    buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(item.data)
                    written = self.lib.archive_write_data(archive, buf, len(item.data))
                    if written < 0:
                        raise ArchiveRuntimeError("System ERROR", self._error(archive))
            finally:
                self.lib.archive_entry_free(entry)
        finally:
            self.lib.archive_write_close(archive)
            self.lib.archive_write_free(archive)

    def _check(self, code: int, handle: int, fatal: bool = False) -> None:
        if code >= AR_OK or code == AR_EOF:
            return
        msg = self._error(handle)
        if fatal:
            raise ArchiveRuntimeError("Cannot open the file as archive", msg)
